verdict.rationale: Entra docs describe device registration and join as the device-identity foundation. They state that device identities are a prerequisite for device-based Conditional Access and for Mobile Device Management through the Microsoft Intune family. That establishes a documented MDM integration path and identity-tied policy enforcement. The evidence only says the integration exists, though; it does not show MDM enrollment or device management in depth. Missing for 10: any evidence of remote lock/wipe, detail on MDM enrollment flows and compliance-policy enforcement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
